title: What’s new on Prime Video in September 2026, including ‘Neagley,’ ‘Drawn Together,’ and ‘Thursday Night Football’
summary: Prime Video’s September lineup also features several new films based on best-selling books.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- The world of


Reacher


expands with


Neagley


, starring Maria Sten, premiering September 16.


- Live sports include WNBA, NWSL, New York Yankees, and the 2026 debut of


Thursday Night Football.


- New films based on best-selling books include


Drawn Together


,


The Love Hypothesis


, and


You+Me - Against the World


.


---


September kicks off on


[Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/what-you-need-to-know-about-prime-video) with the return of the NFL and the regular-season debut of


[Thursday Night Football](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/how-to-watch-thursday-night-football-on-prime-video) , headlined by a marquee matchup between the Detroit Lions and Buffalo Bills.


The month also brings an expansion of the


Reacher


universe with


[Neagley](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/watch-neagley-reacher-prime-video) , starring Maria Sten as the fan-favorite Chicago private investigator, plus several new movies adapted from best-selling international books—including


Drawn Together


and


You+Me - Against the World—


as well as other exciting Prime Original films.


[Everything you need to know about ‘Thursday Night Football’ on Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/everything-you-need-to-know-about-thursday-night-football-on-prime-video)


Find out who’s playing, how to watch, and who won each week. Plus, get all the latest ‘Thursday Night Football’ news from Prime Video.


More live sports continue with WNBA, NWSL, and New York Yankees games, while


The Grand Tour


returns with a brand-new lineup of hosts for the iconic motoring series.


Prime Video is included with an


[Amazon Prime membership](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-membership-worth-it) , which costs $14.99 a month or $139 a year in the U.S. Discounted memberships are also available for


[young adults](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-for-young-adults) and


[qualifying government assistance recipients](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-access-discounted-membership) . Check your local Amazon website for information on Prime membership pricing in your region.


Not a member yet? Start a


[30-day free trial](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-free-trial) today.


Here’s everything that’s coming to Prime Video in the United States in September.


## Spotlight: ‘Neagley’


September 16.


The world of


[Reacher](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/how-to-watch-thursday-night-football-on-prime-video) is expanding with actress Maria Sten starring in


Neagley


as Chicago private investigator Frances Neagley. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell-bent on justice. Using everything she’s learned from Reacher and her time as a member of the Army’s 110th Special Investigations Unit, Neagley puts herself on a dangerous path to uncover a menacing evil.


## More Prime Originals


### ‘The Runner’


September 2.


In this pulse-pounding psychological film, Gal Gadot stars as Maia Marten, a high-powered London lawyer whose world shatters when her son is taken during her morning run. The instructions are simple and merciless: keep moving, follow every command, and tell no one.


### ‘The Grand Tour’


September 4.


[The Grand Tour](https://www.amazon.com/The-Grand-Tour-Season-1/dp/B086VXCTGW)


returns with a fresh lineup as celebrated trainspotter Francis Bourgeois joins “Throttle House” creators James Engelsman and Thomas Holland behind the wheel. Across six globe-trotting episodes, the trio tackles motoring's most delightfully absurd questions—from crossing the Angolan desert in track cars to exploring Malaysia's vibrant car culture and testing cutting-edge performance cars in California.


### ‘Drawn Together’


September 9.


[Based on Marfil ,](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/marfil-drawn-together-prime-video) the first book in Mercedes Ron's bestselling


Enfrentados


duology, this romantic thriller follows the daughter of a Spanish business tycoon whose life is upended after a kidnapping leads her overprotective father to assign the enigmatic Sebastian Moore as her bodyguard. Ester Expósito (


Venus


) stars as Marfil Cortés and Hugo Diego García (


The Substance


) stars as Sebastian Moore.


### ‘A Love Other Than Yours’


September 12.


The series follows Namgung Ho and Lee Mi-do, a couple whose 10-year relationship has matured from burning passion into quiet trust. Ho believes marriage is the natural next step. Mi-do, a film director, finds her heart swayed by another man during a career setback. Together, they must decide: move forward with marriage, or finally let go?


### ‘You+Me - Against the World’


September 18.


Prime Video's first French young adult Original film is based on Emma Green's best-selling trilogy that has sold nearly 1 million copies in France.


[The film follows Alma](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/you-me-toi-moi-prime-video) , an aspiring filmmaker hiding her true passion from her wealthy family, and Vadim, a magnetic rebel with a troubled past, who are forced together on a student film project and fall for each other despite their differences.


### ‘The Love Hypothesis’


September 23.


[The Love Hypothesis](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/love-hypothesis-prime-video)


follows Olive, a brilliant Ph.D. candidate focused on her future in academia. But when she realizes her best friend Ahn has fallen for her crush, Jeremy, Olive impulsively kisses intimidating professor Adam Carlsen to prove she’s moved on. What begins as a desperate act of friendship spirals into a fake relationship with rules, boundaries, and a mutually beneficial agreement.


### ‘Go Deep: The DeSean Jackson Story’


September 24.


Following DeSean Jackson's unexpected rise from 9-year-old Pop Warner prodigy to one of the NFL's greatest wide receivers,


Go Deep: The DeSean Jackson Story


is excavated from thousands of hours of home video. Jackson’s brother, Byron, filmed more than 30 years of footage to reconnect with their estranged father. The result was the project of a lifetime that revealed a complex relationship between two brothers, their father, and what family truly means under immense pressure.
